# Pixel Memory Match

A simple, offline browser-based memory matching game with 8 pairs of colored cards.

## Features

- 8 pairs of colored cards (16 total) shuffled randomly
- Flip two cards at a time; matched pairs stay open
- Move counter
- Win message when all pairs are matched
- New Game button to reset
- Keyboard accessible (Tab to navigate, Enter/Space to flip)
- Responsive layout from 360px wide
- No external dependencies or network requests

## How to Run

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server or build step required.

## Files

- `index.html` – game structure
- `styles.css` – theming and layout
- `script.js` – game logic
